change: Move the long-trend and K-line-congestion comparison from daily MACD crosses to completed weekly and monthly bullish MACD crosses, with one-to-six-month holding windows
coverage: 2,518 eligible histories; 2000-01-03 through 2026-08-21; 48,859 weekly and 10,993 monthly cross events before factor filtering

specification.signal: weekly or monthly MACD bullish cross confirmed only after the full period closes
comparisons: signal-date long trend plus cross plus daily-close congestion

result: Monthly crosses were materially more consistent at longer horizons than weekly crosses. Six-month raw win rates were 64.5%, 68.1% and 70.3% for monthly crosses versus 59.6%, 60.9% and 56.2% for weekly crosses. The long-trend gate changed monthly six-month win rates by only +0.4, +0.6 and -0.4 percentage points. K-line congestion did not validate as an add-on: monthly six-month deltas versus the long-trend monthly baseline were -0.3, -10.5 and -41.3 points, with only seven completed 2026 congestion samples at six months; weekly deltas were -1.1, -3.0 and +3.5 points.
known_limitations: weekly and monthly events overlap across holding windows
raw long-horizon win rates include equity-market drift
the 2026 six-month congestion subset is incomplete and too small
no fees or historical quote-level slippage

change: Score six independent confirmations on top of long trend, at least 5% pullback from the prior 60-day high, and a daily MACD bullish cross
coverage: 2,518 eligible histories; 2000-01-03 through 2026-08-21; 69,265 development, 7,018 validation and 1,465 forward core events

specification.scoring: one point per component, thresholds zero through six

result: Equal-weight scoring did not validate. At 20 days, the core won 56.0%, 53.1% and 55.0%; requiring at least four confirmations produced 58.0%, 51.6% and 54.3%. At 100 days, the core won 59.1%, 60.0% and 63.5%; at least four confirmations produced 61.1%, 60.4% and 57.1%. Five- and six-point groups were too small. The overhead unfilled-gap component increased win rate in all three 20-day stages by +1.1, +2.0 and +3.6 points, but robust-return deltas were +0.07, +0.38 and -0.12, so it remains a candidate rather than a validated weight.
known_limitations: equal weighting may dilute useful components with weak ones
five- and six-point samples are insufficient
gap and FVG rules use daily OHLC rather than intraday data
overlapping events are not independent
no fees or quote-level slippage
